items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: So this buddy of mine, B. Walker comes by.

ctx.x: Just a second. So this guy says, "Is Joe there?"

Yeah. So this buddy of mine, B. Walker comes by. I'm at my brother's house which he remodeled. An old family house but he remodeled and did it up real prettily, you know. So he said, "Well, ask Joe to come to the door because there's a lady out here that wants to see him." Now, remember the jack-o-lanterns and also let me interject this idea, the player piano. You remember the player piano years ago?.
